svg.text: Deployed Google Cloud prototype • project qnova-ai-builder • architecture snapshot 18 October 2026
Application runtime and data remain on Google Cloud. Boundary is a project grouping, not a VPC or private-network claim.
Each service's location is shown below.
Browser SDK: sign-in, verification and token refresh
OIDC recovery: outbox dispatch + expired leases
People assign source authority and accept scope.
The API binds approval to exact payload + revisions.
One transaction writes task, receipt, revision and audit.
Only three finding kinds; exact source citations.
Maximum 3 model requests / 60 seconds per invocation.
Task creation does not prove acceptance or closure.
Native editable shapes • Logical request/data flows, not firewall topology • Deployment observed; complete end-to-end acceptance remains tracked in harness/build-log.md
